reuse.why: Extends the existing shouldFillCategory/HiddenPolicy abstraction in fill-rules.ts with an 'include-hidden' policy instead of inventing a new check.

duplication.why: The includeHiddenCategories ? 'include-hidden' : <policy> ternary is pasted into all six actions, and four actions also get a conditional SQL hidden filter, so the hidden rule is decided again in each query.

placement.why: The policy lives in fill-rules.ts where it belongs, but the mapping from flag to policy and the hidden filtering in SQL stay in each action instead of in the shared selection.

scope.why: Only the flag, its handling in each month-wide action, one test and a release note.

maintainability.why: A future change to hidden handling must touch fill-rules plus six ternaries and four interpolated WHERE clauses that can fall out of sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg, set12MonthAvg and setLastMonthSpending filter hidden categories in their own SQL (now made conditional) alongside shouldFillCategory's hiddenPolicy

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated ternaries and SQL conditionals in budget/actions.ts are plain copies, not reshaped
